prohibited_inferences: Do not treat this synthetic fixture as evidence about Electric Twin, News UK, Dentsu, or any named deployment.
Do not infer manipulative intent from option-set starvation.
Do not assign zero preference to an option that was not offered.
Do not treat a fallback choice as the person's first choice.
Do not treat abstention as dislike without an identified observation model.
Do not treat a choice share among offered options as a full-population preference distribution.

interpretation_contract.what_this_is: A deterministic synthetic control showing that the same fixed population produces different observed choice distributions when an institution changes the available option set and unavailable-option behavior.
interpretation_contract.what_this_is_not: A real deployment finding, evidence of preference manipulation, evidence of intent, or a claim that every person responds to unavailable options through fallback or abstention.
interpretation_contract.copy_ready_caveat: This fixture proves an identification boundary: choices observed under a restricted option set reveal behavior among the available options, not the population's complete first-choice distribution or authorization of the option set.
